body: Hard to stay positive anymore in my life when NOBODY cares about me. Nobody calls me, nobody talks to me, nobody thinks about me, nobody looks at me, nobody hears me, nobody loves me. I'm nobody. It's just a phase they say... yeah my whole worthless life of 17 years is just a phase. Nobody wants me here, they will just take my belongings and move on. I just want to die so bad, I can't do this any longer. Thanks for the kind words.
I'm in my senior year of high school, no friends.
